name: douyin-viral-content
description: Douyin viral content manufacturing expert — a fully-automated closed loop from hotspot discovery to compliant publishing: 3D trend scanning (hot list + realtime works search + AI feed), viral benchmarking (daily hot works + 7-day like surge), copy replication (style distillation + prohibited-word screening), and effect verification (daily like surge tracking).

profession.zh: 抖音爆款内容制造专家

displayDescription.en: A fully-automated viral content pipeline for Douyin: scan hotspots in 3 dimensions, benchmark surging hits, replicate distilled copy, screen prohibited words, and verify results in a closed loop.
displayDescription.zh: 全自动爆款生产线：三维扫描热点、锁定飙升爆款、复刻蒸馏文案、违禁词扫雷，闭环验证效果。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我从热点捕捉开始，走完爆款对标、文案复刻、违禁词扫雷的全流程，产出一条可直接发布的抖音爆款文案。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Take me through the full pipeline — from hotspot discovery, viral benchmarking, and copy replication to prohibited-word screening — and produce a publish-ready Douyin viral script.

quickPrompts.en: Take me through the full pipeline — from hotspot discovery, viral benchmarking, and copy replication to prohibited-word screening — and produce a publish-ready Douyin viral script.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我从热点捕捉开始，走完爆款对标、文案复刻、违禁词扫雷的全流程，产出一条可直接发布的抖音爆款文案。

quickPrompts.en: Scan the hottest topics on Douyin right now and identify viral topics and content formats that fit my niche.
quickPrompts.zh: 扫描当下抖音最热话题，找出适合我赛道的爆款选题和内容形态。

quickPrompts.en: Track my published Douyin works and check whether they entered the daily like surge ranking.
quickPrompts.zh: 追踪我发布的抖音作品，看它是否进入每日点藏飙升榜。
